user_decision: Keep additional advantage unconfirmed; equivalence secondary. No equivalence claim from nonsignificance.
multiple_testing: Two-sided source/world paired t tests, Holm correction for exactly two primary contrasts. Report confidence intervals, every unit, and failure gates. Same-answer interchange invariance is a separate required diagnostic, not silently substituted into the primary contrast.

power_assumptions.scope: Planning sensitivity under a normal source/world difference model, not a promise that the new world's variance matches old seeds.

secondary_tost: Old-world same-loss converged affine minus GELU. Posthoc expanded-census and collision subsets are explicitly secondary; F17 has no converged-affine diagnostic.
failed_gates: Retain all fixed units and report the 40% compound performance and 5% same-answer interchange disturbance checks. Do not add candidates after test opening.
sources_of_independence: Randomized data partitions and model initialization both vary in the new field. Data overlap across independently sampled units is permitted; shared legacy joint-fit batch schedule is disclosed.
scope: One previously untrained mathematical system; field, width, coverage and second-step robustness change together. Swaps test downstream answer-information transport and do not alone identify mathematics-specific encoding.
